architectureDecisions: D1 — Files: packages/agentic-system/src/supervised-backend.js exporting mapBackendOrderToAgentTask, runSupervisedBackendWork; packages/agentic-system/src/index.js re-exports those two; tests in packages/agentic-system/test/bb100-supervised-backend.test.js. Living: docs/living/system/agentic-application/state.md and capabilities.md.

D2 — mapBackendOrderToAgentTask(order, context, { verifications }) builds AGENT_TASK_V1 { id: order.id, repositoryRoot from context.repository or caller, baseRevision: order.revision (40-hex), prompt: order.objective text or caller prompt, verifications }. requiredFiles are not added here (BB-102). Context files are not copied into the prompt in this task.

D3 — runSupervisedBackendWork({ tool, order, context, verifications, maxAttempts, timeoutMs, permissionProfile, env }) validates the order, calls runSupervisedTask, and projects AGENT_SUPERVISED_RESULT_V1 to BackendWorkResultSchema: ACCEPTED -> APPLIED with revision = acceptedSha; EXHAUSTED/NO_CHANGE -> FAILED; TOOL_UNAVAILABLE -> BLOCKED with reason TOOL_UNAVAILABLE. Evidence artifacts use the existing mutation/typecheck/tests helpers from backend-worker.js only when status is APPLIED, bound to acceptedSha.
D4 — Do not inject createSupervisedAgentStrategy into createBackendWorker. Probe shows BackendWorker evaluate is mutation-only and workspace.act is not RUN_AGENT_TOOL.

D5 — Fake CLI tests reuse packages/agent-tools/test/fixtures/fake-agent.mjs via defineAgentTool and FAKE_AGENT_SCENARIO. SB3 covers FIX_FIRST APPLIED, NEVER_FIX FAILED, CLAIM_SUCCESS_NO_EDIT FAILED, AUTH_FAIL BLOCKED/FAILED without APPLIED, FIX_AFTER_FEEDBACK APPLIED only after retry.

D6 — createBackendWorker remains the default path. An SB1 test reads backend-worker.js source (or a dedicated import graph assertion) and asserts it does not contain 'agent-tools' or 'runSupervisedTask'.
D7 — Evidence basis: executed productization probe; BB-096 workspace/verifier; BB-097 supervisor.

D8 — Research gap closed at READY: confirm BackendWorkResultSchema status enum contains APPLIED/FAILED/BLOCKED as used in D3; if a status name differs, rename the projection to the delivered enum without widening it.
